name: Foulhide

abilities.name: Swipe
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Summon Selene's Roses
abilities.description: Throughout the fight, stranglers will spawn in large numbers to attack the group. They tend only to attack players near them and can be safely ignored if far away.

abilities.name: Vicious Maul
abilities.description: The boss rears up and slams down dealing moderate physical damage in front of itself as indicated by a red cone. This will also instantly kill any Selene's Roses hit.

abilities.name: Trampling Charge
abilities.description: The boss charges forward dealing moderate physical damage and knocking down all players hit as indicated by a red rectangle. At the end of the charge Foulhide is stunned for a short moment. This will also kill any Selene's Roses hit by dealing 110% of their Max Health in oblivion damage.

abilities.name: Horrifying Roar
abilities.description: The boss roars fearing all players. Break free to counter this.

notes: He is seemingly the Primal Spirit later summoned by Selene, who later appears in Lair of Maarselok as Selene's Claws.
related_quests: Knowledge Gained: Help guide a Mages Guild expedition through a dangerous forest.
Pledge: Selene's Web: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Selene's Web.
summary: Foulhide is an enormous bear found inside Selene's Web.
